welcome.title: Welcome to AwesomeB
welcome.subtitle: AwesomeB(rowser)
welcome.intro: For AwesomeB to function correctly, a search engine must be configured as a minimum prerequisite. Please provide the URL for your desired search engine:
welcome.note: Note: The search engines can be modified at a later point within the main configuration settings.

general.downloadLocationDescription: Set the default download location for files.
general.historyRetentionDescription: Number of days to keep browsing history.
general.closedTabsRetentionDescription: Number of days to keep closed tabs history.
general.informationDescription: Here you can view information about the application version, the file path where configuration, session, history, etc., are stored, the underlying Chromium version, and the project repository.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.description: Manage isolated CHrome profiles (partitions) with separate cookies, sessions, and storage for each workspace or user.
profiles.name: Name
profiles.restartNote: To apply the new changes to the profiles, it is necessary to restart the browser.

themes.title: Themes
themes.description: Manage custom themes to personalize the appearance of your desktops.
themes.name: Name
themes.uiThemeDescription: Customize the look of the AwesomeB UI with themes created by the community.

permissions.securityLevelDescription:
This setting determines the level of access granted to websites regarding your device's functionalities (sensors, APIs, etc.).

Standard: Allows common permissions necessary for most web pages to function correctly.
Strict: Requires your explicit consent for every permission a website attempts to use, offering maximum privacy.
permissions.permissionsDescription: Manage the permissions required for the extension to function properly.

shortcuts.defaultMapDescription: Define a default keyboard layout that suits you best. You can then customize specific keys to your preferences.
shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Click on a shortcut key to change its combination. Press Escape to cancel.

bookmarks.title: Bookmarks
bookmarks.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this bookmark?

history.title: History
history.clearHistoryConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear all history?

tabMarks.title: Tab marks
tabMarks.helpMark: Press "m" followed by a letter to mark the active tab (e.g., ma, mb, mc, ...)
tabMarks.helpDeleteOne: Delete the mark from the active tab
tabMarks.helpSelect: Select the tab marked with that letter (e.g., a, b, c, ...)

tabCertificateError.title: Cannot Connect to the Website
tabCertificateError.description: The certificate for url {{url}} is invalid. As a result, the connection between your browser and the server is not properly encrypted, which could allow an attacker to intercept or steal sensitive data. Error code: {{error}}.
tabCertificateError.proceed: I Understand the risks and choose to proceed anyway.

newTab.title: New Tab
newTab.queryPlaceholder: Enter a query or a valid url...

login.title: Login
login.description: The site ({{host}}) requires a username and password to continue.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.intro: AwesomeB offers limited support for Chrome extensions. At this time, installation must be done manually: place your extensions in the following directory ({{path}}) and then click the Refresh Extensions button.

extensionPopupFailed.message: Sorry, but the extension popup failed to load. Please try again later.

certificateInfo.title: Certificate Info
certificateInfo.failed: Failed to get the certificate info.

clientCertificate.title: Choose a client certificate
clientCertificate.description: Site {{url}} is requesting a client certificate for authentication. Please choose a certificate to proceed.

requestPermission.title: Grant permission
requestPermission.description: The site {{host}} is requesting permission for {{permission}}.

dividerAdd.title: Add Tab Container Divider
dividerAdd.listPlaceholder: Filter and select a tab container...

dividerRemove.title: Remove a divider from a tab container
dividerRemove.listPlaceholder: Filter and select a tab container...

dividersRemoveAll.title: Remove all dividers from a desktop

closedTabsClear.confirmMessage: Are you sure you want to clear all closed tabs history?

debug.title: Debug
debug.intro: List of all registered web contents with useful information about each one. Remember that you can filter and sort.
debug.tabIndex: Tab index data for all tabs in all windows/desktops.
